description: This file contains utility functions for grouping Card objects based on properties or creator/modifier, used in a board or task management context.

methods.name: groupCardsByOptions
methods.description: Groups cards based on provided option IDs and a property template.

methods.name: getOptionGroups
methods.description: Separates cards into visible and hidden groups based on option IDs and property template.

methods.name: getVisibleAndHiddenGroups
methods.description: Main exported function that returns visible and hidden groups, handling special cases for 'createdBy', 'updatedBy', or 'person' property types.

methods.name: getPersonGroups
methods.description: Groups cards by creator or modifier, separating into visible and hidden groups.
